# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

This repository is a Solution Engineering Workflow pack.

Use it to move from raw business input to requirement documents, architecture/design artifacts, AIDs, ServiceNow architecture/design, ServiceNow data model, ERDs, review responses, and final solution baselines.

Always enforce:

- no invented business or architecture decisions,
- explicit assumptions and open questions,
- frozen requirements before formal architecture freeze,
- traceability from requirements to architecture decisions and design artifacts,
- no secrets or sensitive values in outputs,
- final baseline only after explicit user approval.

Write outputs under `workspace/` using the phase folders.
